response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total FROM c) SELECT c.player_id, c.award_count, CASE WHEN t.total IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(c.award_count AS REAL) / t.total END AS fraction FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC, c.player_id ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each manager_award row counts as one award; players are grouped by player_id, and rows with NULL player_id form one group.
Ties in fraction are broken by player_id ascending for determinism; the fraction is count divided by the sum of all counts (equal to total rows in manager_award), as a real number.
